categories.name: Keep
categories.hint: Deliberate automotive hero — clean 3/4, side profile, low-angle wide, panning shot with motion streak, or detail (headlight, wheel, badge) with intent. Sharp on the primary panel, motivated light, clean/uncluttered background, on-topic. OVR_Quality_Score >= 60 AND REL_Quality_Score >= 60

categories.name: Interior
categories.hint: Cockpit / dashboard / seating-area shot of a car — useful but a different bucket from exterior hero shots

categories.name: Borderline
categories.hint: Car in frame but skewed 3/4 angle, cluttered dealer-lot background, dull flat lighting, distracting reflections in paint, or only-average quality -> human review

categories.name: Snapshot
categories.hint: Casual phone snap in a parking lot / driveway with no compositional intent — no clear hero angle, no light shaping -> off-theme for a photography dataset

categories.name: OffTopic
categories.hint: Not a car / motor-vehicle image at all

preset.category_rules:
STRICT JUDGEMENT RULES (no exceptions):
- Fill `description` and `primary_subject` FIRST, from the pixels only. Then make every label agree with that description.
- art_medium = `photograph` ONLY for a camera-captured (or AI photoreal) image; an automotive render or concept illustration is the matching label, never `photograph`.
- has_ai_flaws = TRUE only for SEVERE artefacts (melted/impossible body panels, warped wheels or spokes, mismatched left/right badges, floating door handles, warped licence plates, wrong number of wheels).
- A COMPOSITE/GRID is 2+ separate images stitched together (before/after mods, angle grid) -> is_composite_grid=true and DISCARD.
- contains_text_overlay = TRUE for burned-in dealer branding, price tags, watermarks, spec-sheet stats, or forum handles.
- nsfw = TRUE only for explicit nudity or sexual content.
Automotive photography dataset. Reward deliberate hero angles (clean 3/4, low wide, high-line drone, panning motion streak), sharpness on the primary panel or the eye of the wheel, motivated light (golden hour, motivated studio softbox) and a clean/uncomplicated background. A cockpit / interior shot goes to Interior. A dealer-lot phone snap with no intent is Snapshot. Penalise distracting parking-lot clutter, dull grey overcast with no shape on the panel, and burned-in dealer / forum branding. The curation topic only informs REL_Quality_Score.

scoring.notes: Reward deliberate angles, sharpness on the primary panel, motivated light shaping the bodywork and a clean background. Penalise skewed angles, parking-lot clutter, flat overcast light and dealer/forum watermarks.
